medium.en: Triptych of woodblock prints; ink and colour on paper

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1858. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1858 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A three-sheet panorama of a deep mountain gorge buried in snow. White cliffs and pines crowd together, a dark blue river winds along the bottom, and a few tiny houses and a bridge are tucked into the drifts.
alt.zh: 三张拼成的全景：一道深深的山谷埋在雪中。白色的山崖和松树挤在一起，深蓝的河在谷底蜿蜒，几间小屋和一座桥藏在雪堆里。

note.en: Late in his career Hiroshige designed three triptychs on the classical triad of snow, moon and flowers; this is the snow. The Kiso road was the inland route between Edo and Kyoto, higher and slower than the coastal Tōkaidō. The scale is the point: people and houses are nearly lost, and the mountains are allowed to be enormous and quiet.
note.zh: 广重晚年以“雪月花”这一古典三题设计了三组三联画，这是其中的“雪”。木曾路是江户与京都之间的山中通道，比沿海的东海道更高、更慢。重点在尺度：人和房屋几乎看不见，山被允许巨大而安静。
